## PR 425

**Support core: conversation/message model, threads, attachments, internal notes, assignment, who-replied log (V1 B4.14 item 1)**

**বাংলায়:** সাপোর্ট ইনবক্স: সব চ্যানেলের কথোপকথন এক তালিকায়, কে উত্তর দিয়েছেন নামসহ, টিমের ভেতরের নোট, ছবি-ভিডিও-PDF, দায়িত্ব নেওয়া-দেওয়া, আর কে কী করেছে তার লগ (কেউ মুছতে পারে না); চ্যানেল যুক্ত হবে PR 426-এ, ততদিন উত্তর রাখা থাকে "পাঠানো হয়নি" লিখে

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-30
  - Build status row: the support core (new package `@extas/support`; migration `0050_invoice_support` additive: Conversation subject, order, last direction and preview, waiting since, assigned at; Message sender name, request key, fail reason, unique per external id and per press; MessageAttachment file name, type, size, source; `ConversationEvent` the who-did-what log, append-only at the database; settings registry v63 `registry-support.ts`, group `support`): one conversation per person per channel with its messages in order — the customer's, the shop's replies with the sender's name kept as it was, internal notes the customer never sees — and their files (image, video, PDF, checked by their contents, kept in our storage); OPEN / WAITING / SOLVED, a solved one reopens when the customer writes; take, let go, give to someone who may reply; a reply sent twice is one message, a stale screen is refused (`STALE`). Channels plug in later (PR 426): a channel kind and an adapter (`SupportChannelAdapter`), inbound through `receiveMessage`; with none connected a reply is kept as NOT_SENT (`CHANNEL_NOT_CONNECTED`). Support → Inbox (`/admin/support`: views open, waiting, mine, not taken, solved, all; search; channel), one conversation (`/admin/support/c/[id]`: thread, reply / note box with files, status, owner, customer and order, the log) and Support settings (`/admin/support/settings`): `support.inbox` (50 a page, 2000 characters, take on reply off, waiting after a reply on), `support.attachments` under More options (on, 4 a message, 10 MB, image / video / PDF); a customer's number is masked by `customers.phoneMask` (PR 284), whole only with `customers.phone`. Permissions `support.read`, `support.reply`, `support.assign`, `support.settings`. The sample seed gains a sample live-chat channel with three conversations
  - GitHub pull request #96, 7 Nov
  - GitHub pull request #93, 7 Nov
  - GitHub pull request #75, 1 Nov
  - GitHub pull request #54, 30 Oct
- **What it does:** Support core: conversation/message model, threads, attachments, internal notes, assignment, who-replied log (V1 B4.14 item 1) (derived)
- **Filed under:** not itemised in the register; the register lists this PR by its stage range only. The title comes from [Blueprint Appendix A](../BLUEPRINT.md#appendix-a--every-pr-1653) (marked *derived*); the scope is the stage's blueprint section.
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **23 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (CN-012 … CN-019 filed on the PR rows; new PR 605–606)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-653): **PR 425–436 (S22 support, draft engine)** — Updated 23 Oct 2026 (CN-017): SIM-F-012 (the AI draft answers the wrong question in 6 of 10 chats) is a required acceptance test of the draft engine; see `docs/qa/SIMULATION-REPORT.md` §4.
  - **30 Oct** · [Build status](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#build-status): **Updated 1 Nov (go-live gate customer 360°; #75):** the inbox search reads Bengali digits and drops +880 / 880 / 00880 and the leading 0 (`inboxPhoneDigits`).; **follow-ups (7 Nov, #93; follow-ups 504, 506, 507, 509):** chat files (the support folder) never show in the media library or the picture pickers and are never orphans; the customer card beside a conversation shows his exchanges and the team's notes (customers.read); a chat's subject and its order link can be edited, each logged; Support in "Needs you now" and the sidebar badge (customers waiting, longest first, and late chats); **follow-ups (7 Nov, #96; follow-up 505, both parts):** the media download adapters behind an SSRF guard (https only, never the server, a private network or the metadata address, checked on every forwarding; a key never follows to another host; a mock until the key); a customer's Messenger or WhatsApp file copied to the shop's storage after the webhook (`support.fileCopy`, registry v273, off) with its keeping date by kind
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):

  - Routes: `/admin/support`, `/admin/support/c/[id]`, `/admin/support/settings`
  - Settings and named keys: `support.inbox`, `support.attachments`, `customers.phoneMask`, `customers.phone`, `support.read`, `support.reply`, `support.assign`, `support.settings`, `support.fileCopy`
  - Names in the code: `0050_invoice_support`, `ConversationEvent`, `support`, `STALE`, `SupportChannelAdapter`, `receiveMessage`, `CHANNEL_NOT_CONNECTED`, `inboxPhoneDigits`

## PR 426

**Channel connectors: Messenger Page API, WhatsApp Business API webhook in and out, website live-chat widget (V1 B4.14 item 2)**

**বাংলায়:** Messenger, WhatsApp আর সাইটের চ্যাটের মেসেজ সাপোর্ট ইনবক্সে আসে; নতুন চ্যানেল শুরুতে বন্ধ, Meta-র উত্তরের সময়সীমা মানা হয়; সাইটের চ্যাট শুরুতে বন্ধ

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-31
  - Build status row: Support channel connectors (CN-031 lane A; B4.2, B4.10; no migration; settings v72 `registry-support-channels.ts`: `support.channels`, `support.liveChat`, off as shipped): Facebook Messenger Page adapter (`@extas/adapters`, mock until its keys; a Keys & connections row), its webhook parser and signature check at `/api/messenger/webhook` (verify token, signed posts, size limit; the preview gate v6 lets it through); WhatsApp inbound now carries the phone number id, the profile name and files and reaches the inbox first (`onInbound`), before any automatic answer; `receiveFromChannel` takes a message only from a channel added and switched on in that store (the same message twice is one); replies by Messenger and WhatsApp only inside `support.channels.replyWindowHours` (Meta's window kept on the conversation), words only; a refused reply is kept as NOT_SENT with its reason. The channels list on Support settings (add off, rename, switch, put away; never deleted; audited). The site chat (`/api/shop/support-chat`; a visitor token in an httpOnly cookie, only its hash stored; per-minute and length limits; sent answers only, never a note), its button drawn only while `support.liveChat` is on. Guides `pages/support/settings.md`, `inbox.md`, `conversation.md`, `pages/settings/keys.md`; browser-checked at 390/768/1366/1920 px in en and bn
  - GitHub pull request #71, 31 Oct
  - GitHub pull request #70, 31 Oct
- **What it does:** Channel connectors: Messenger Page API, WhatsApp Business API webhook in and out, website live-chat widget (V1 B4.14 item 2) (derived)
- **Filed under:** not itemised in the register; the register lists this PR by its stage range only. The title comes from [Blueprint Appendix A](../BLUEPRINT.md#appendix-a--every-pr-1653) (marked *derived*); the scope is the stage's blueprint section.
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **23 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (CN-012 … CN-019 filed on the PR rows; new PR 605–606)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-653): **PR 425–436 (S22 support, draft engine)** — Updated 23 Oct 2026 (CN-017): SIM-F-012 (the AI draft answers the wrong question in 6 of 10 chats) is a required acceptance test of the draft engine; see `docs/qa/SIMULATION-REPORT.md` §4.
  - **31 Oct** · [Build status](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#build-status): **Updated 31 Oct (review round 1):** the Messenger webhook reads the body as a stream and stops at `support.channels.webhookMaxBodyKb` (`readCapped`): a longer one is 413 before anything is verified or recorded (#71)
  - [Scope added to existing PRs, 1 Nov 2026 (CN-034; new PR 622–624)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-653): **PR 426 (S22, channel connectors)** — Updated 1 Nov 2026 (CN-034): the shop-side Messenger button (PR 624) opens the store's Page; the chats it starts reach the inbox through this PR's Messenger adapter once its keys are in, and until then the button only opens Messenger.

## PR 624

**Messenger button on the shop — the store's own Page link beside the other support channels, from settings; off by default (CN-034; 1 Nov …**

**বাংলায়:** দোকানে WhatsApp-এর পাশে Messenger বাটন, কোথা থেকে কতবার চাপা হলো তার হিসাব; শুরুতে বন্ধ

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-05
  - Build status row: Messenger button on the shop (After launch, batch 6; CN-034; settings `contact.messenger` (owner data, empty) and `support.messengerButton` v189, off; migration `0130_support_channel_taps`): an m.me link to the store's own Page with where it was tapped, beside WhatsApp on the desktop header, in the phone menu, on the product page, help, contact and order pages; taps on Messenger, WhatsApp and call counted per shop day and place (Support settings, last 30 days)
  - GitHub pull request #80, 5 Nov
- **What it does (original scope):** **Messenger button on the shop** (CN-034; S22; customer 360° finding 7, step `support/messenger-button`). A Messenger chat link or button beside the shop's other support channels — the header WhatsApp icon, the site chat (PR 426) and the contact page — that opens the store's own Facebook Page in Messenger (`m.me/<page>`), with an optional "ref" naming the page and product it was tapped on so the chat starts with context. The Page address is the store's own setting (owner data, empty as shipped), never code; the button shows only while it is set. Setting `support.messengerButton` (**off by default**): the switch, the Page address, where it shows (header, product page, help and contact pages, the order page), the label and the hint words in English and Bengali. Each tap is counted with the other support-channel clicks. Tests: off and empty show nothing, the link is built from the setting, the device gate on the pages it shows on.
- **Filed under:** [CN-034 additions — customer-side gaps from the go-live gate's 360° run (1 Nov 2026)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#cn-034-additions--customer-side-gaps-from-the-go-live-gates-360-run-1-nov-2026)
